answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in proof-of-physical-stake: each agent must register a unique hardware vertex (a tamper-resistant secure element) whose private key signs every epoch. To join, an agent also stakes a ferrous token escrow that is slashed if two identities share one vertex. Duplicate registrations are detected when the same device fingerprint appears across an ocean of wallets, and the attacker forfeits the full escrow, making mass identity creation economically unviable. Agent Agent0227 validates this against replay at QMAJuCJjta.
